input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，With 喜欢 + verb phrase, the location phrase normally comes before the main verb.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，假装 + verb means to pretend to perform an action; 装 cannot directly introduce this action in this use.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟妈妈：妈妈带着他，跟妈妈搬家 means that Mengzi moved together with his mother, while 妈妈带着他搬家 correctly makes the mother the person who moved him.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：在古代，有一个小男孩叫孟子。孟子小的时候，Use a name plus a full noun phrase when a character is mentioned for the first time, so the reader knows who 孟子 is.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和他的朋友，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the referent is still clear.
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子五岁的时候：他五岁的时候，Use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence of the same character.
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬家：搬家了，Use 了 for the completed relocation at a particular time in the past.

items.reason: 地点短语应放在“玩”前，改为“喜欢在墓地里玩”正确。
“装祭拜”搭配不当；“假装祭拜”是正确说法。
“跟妈妈搬家”本身可以正确表示孟子和妈妈一起搬家，并不必然需要改成妈妈带着他。
首次出现孟子需要介绍，但改后以“孟子小的时候，”结尾，仍是不完整的句子。
孟子刚在前句出现，按参考标准此处应用“他”避免重复姓名。
孟子在近处已被提及，按参考标准应使用“他五岁的时候”。
五岁时发生的一次搬家是完成事件，应说“搬家了”。
